purpose: Research record for two original BrowserHub browser-agent implementation guides: iframe targeting and action-triggered pages/popups.

topicSelection.primarySignal: Browser Use repository issue reports show recurring developer questions about iframe interaction and detecting pages opened by an interaction. These are public support signals, not search volume or BrowserHub traffic.

topics.signal: Browser Use issue #3109: iframe interaction question, opened 2025-09-14; issue body reports Browser Use 0.7.7 and a CAPTCHA checkbox. Historical demand only. The article does not advise solving or bypassing CAPTCHA.

Browser Use issue #3657: interaction-opened background tab report, opened 2025-11-22; issue body reports Browser Use 0.9.7. Issue #4136: BrowserStateSummary reported to omit an interaction-opened tab, opened 2026-02-20 against 0.11.11 and 0.11.9, closed 2026-02-27 after a referenced fix was completed. Both are historical version-specific reports, not current bug claims.

topicSelection.signalLimits: GitHub issue existence, title, reporter-provided version, issue date, and observed state only. No public read count or current search-volume value was found or used. A closed issue is not evidence that every deployment contains the fix.

officialTechnicalSources.title: Playwright: Frames
factsUsed: Page has a main frame and can have iframe child frames
page-level interactions default to main frame

officialTechnicalSources.title: Playwright: FrameLocator API
factsUsed: a selector matching multiple frames throws

officialTechnicalSources.title: Playwright: Pages
factsUsed: one browser context can have multiple pages
popup event wait must be installed before triggering click
new page event can be awaited on a context

officialTechnicalSources.title: Playwright: BrowserContext API
factsUsed: page event covers new pages in a context, including popup pages
new page may still be loading

officialTechnicalSources.title: Playwright: Page API
factsUsed: popup is emitted for a new tab/window associated with a page
closed opener can make popup opener lookup null

offlineFixture.purpose: Small reusable teaching fixture for the frame-locator and popup-event workflows in both guides.
offlineFixture.scope: Uses only Playwright with synthetic srcdoc iframe content and a trusted local button click that opens about:blank. A route handler aborts application-context requests, the script does not navigate to an external URL, use credentials, test CAPTCHA, or inspect a detection website. Browser or operating-system background traffic is outside the fixture's assertion.
offlineFixture.prerequisite: Install Playwright in the consuming project and provide an installed Chromium browser; PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH can select its executable. The public script does not install packages.
offlineFixture.executionStatus: Executed successfully by the root agent on 2026-10-24. The public asset was copied byte-for-byte into a private fixture directory and passed with exit code 0.

assertions: srcdoc iframe labeled field fill and save action
executionEvidence.limits: Context application requests were blocked. Browser or OS background traffic is outside the assertion. No external site, cross-origin fixture, MFA, agent/LLM, CAPTCHA, or production task was tested; this is not a general reliability result.

claimsAndBoundaries: The implementation advice is scoped to the documented Playwright JavaScript API. Browser Use, other agent frameworks, and MCP servers may expose different interfaces; no universal compatibility is claimed.
Cross-origin frame guidance distinguishes browser page-JavaScript same-origin restrictions from supported automation APIs. It does not recommend evading access controls.

The offline synthetic fixture completed successfully for its srcdoc iframe and about:blank popup assertions. No external fixture, live target site, CAPTCHA, MFA, agent/LLM, or production workflow was tested; this is not a general reliability result.
No Playwright current version number or Browser Use latest version is claimed in article copy. Official docs are a moving target, and the copy records its check date.
